calculation.description: Contrarian cross-asset signal that reverses the recent 20-session price shock after volatility scaling, with a small 60-session trend anchor penalty; shifted one session to avoid look-ahead. Higher values indicate stronger expected forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: 60D IC was negative in 2020-2023 (-0.012516), near zero in 2024-2026 (+0.007757), strongly positive in 2027-2029 (+0.145963) and 2030-2032 (+0.174879), and positive in 2033-2034 (+0.046859). Interpret uncertainty conservatively given the 15-asset cross-section despite 4,276 daily observations.
